description: This file defines a routing system for handling HTTP requests, including classes for tokenizing route patterns, compiling them into regexes, and matching requests to handlers. It is part of a web server framework.

classes.name: RouteTokenizer
classes.description: Tokenizes route pattern strings into components for regex compilation.

classes.name: RouteCompiler
classes.description: Compiles tokenized route patterns into regex objects for matching.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: Manages route registration and request handling by matching request paths to handlers.

methods.name: literal
methods.description: Returns a token for a literal string component.

methods.name: slash
methods.description: Returns a token for a slash component.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Returns a token for a named group in the route pattern.

methods.name: star
methods.description: Returns a token for a wildcard component.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Tokenizes an input route pattern string into pattern tokens.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a list of tokens into a regex pattern.

methods.name: process_literal
methods.description: Processes a literal token into a regex escaped string.

methods.name: process_slash
methods.description: Processes a slash token into a '/' character.

methods.name: process_group
methods.description: Processes a group token into a named regex group.

methods.name: process_star
methods.description: Processes a star token into a regex pattern for matching any characters.

methods.name: compile_path_match
methods.description: Converts a route pattern string into a compiled regex object.

methods.name: Router
methods.description: Handles route registration and request matching for a web server.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a route with methods, path pattern, and handler.

methods.name: get_handler
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate handler for a given request based on method and path.
